info.title: Date Math
info.description: Deterministic date and time math for AI agents: date differences, business days, date arithmetic, time zone conversion and calendar facts. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, $0.001); probes and spec are free. All inputs are JSON bodies; all responses are JSON objects. Errors return {"error":{"code","message","example"}}.
info.x-guidance: Date Math does exact date and time arithmetic so you don't have to. Every tool is POST with a JSON body, returns a JSON object, and costs $0.001 (x402, USDC on Base). POST /v1/diff: days/weeks/months/business days between two dates (pass country, e.g. "US", to skip its public holidays). POST /v1/add: the date N days/weeks/months/business days before or after a date. POST /v1/convert: a time in another IANA time zone (DST-aware). POST /v1/info: weekday, ISO week, quarter or leap-year status of a date. POST /v1/holidays: a country's public holidays for a year. POST /v1/overlap: when working hours overlap across time zones (meeting slots). POST /v1/cron: explain a cron expression and list its next runs. POST /v1/parse: turn text like "next Friday at 3pm" into an exact datetime. POST /v1/city: the time zone and local time of a city by name. POST /v1/recurrence: concrete dates for an iCal RRULE ("every 2nd Tuesday"). POST /v1/business_hours: SLA deadline N working hours from now, or working hours elapsed. POST /v1/business_day: is a date a business day (and if not, which holiday), plus the next/previous business day. POST /v1/pay_dates: payroll or billing dates (monthly, 15th and last, biweekly, weekly) moved off weekends and holidays. POST /v1/stay: Schengen-style 90/180 stay limits (days used, days left, longest stay from an entry date). POST /v1/timestamp: convert mixed Unix/Excel/ISO/slash-date timestamps to UTC and flag ambiguous ones. POST /v1/dst: a zone's DST clock changes and whether a local time is skipped or repeated. POST /v1/sla: support-ticket SLA clock (business minutes elapsed/remaining, breached, deadline; pauses outside hours). POST /v1/free_slots: meeting slots when every participant is free (working hours per zone minus busy blocks). POST /v1/subscription: billing period, next renewal, cancel-by date and proration. POST /v1/market: NYSE/Nasdaq/LSE/Tokyo hours, holidays, open now, settlement date. POST /v1/date_range: "last month", "this quarter", "YTD", "last 7 days" or "2026-Q3" as exact start/end dates and times in a time zone, with an optional comparison period. POST /v1/business_day_schedule: next runs of a holiday-aware schedule ("3rd business day at 09:00", "every Monday or the next business day") and whether it runs today. POST /v1/time_buckets: hour/day/week/month buckets for charts, DST-aware. Free: GET /v1/now returns the current date and time (call it when you need today's date). Business-day tools accept workdays (e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; datetimes are ISO 8601 with Z or an offset; time zones are IANA names. Errors return HTTP 400 with {"error":{"code","message","example"}}; example is a valid body for that tool. Also available as an MCP server at /mcp.

post.summary: Reporting period (last month, this quarter, YTD, last 7 days, 2026-Q3) to exact start and end dates and times

period.description: Relative: today, yesterday, tomorrow, this_/last_/next_ + week|month|quarter|half|year, week_to_date|month_to_date|quarter_to_date|year_to_date (or wtd, mtd, qtd, ytd), last_N_days|weeks|months|quarters|years, next_N_days|weeks|months|... Spaces work too ("last 7 days"). last_N_days = N complete days before today; last_N_months = N complete calendar months before this one. Explicit: 2026, 2026-H1, 2026-Q3 or "Q3 2026", 2026-03, 2026-W14 (ISO week), 2026-03-15

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (default UTC)

as_of.description: Reference date for relative periods: YYYY-MM-DD, or a datetime (its local date is used). Default: today in timezone

week_start.description: First day of the week. monday = ISO weeks (labels like 2026-W46)

fiscal_year_start.description: Month the fiscal year starts (1 = January). Quarters, halves and years follow it; fiscal years are named by the calendar year they end in (start 7: FY2027 = July 2026 – June 2027)

include_today.description: End the range with today (inclusive). Default true for *_to_date periods, false for last_N_* periods (complete days only)

compare.description: Also return a comparison range. previous_period: the same length immediately before (to-date periods: the same number of days into the previous unit). previous_year: the same dates a year earlier (weeks: 52 weeks earlier, same weekdays)

as_of.description: The local date that relative periods were resolved against

start.description: Local start, ISO 8601 with offset (local midnight)

end_exclusive.description: Local end, exclusive: the midnight after end_date. Filter with >= start and < end_exclusive

start.description: Local start, ISO 8601 with offset (local midnight)

end_exclusive.description: Local end, exclusive: the midnight after end_date. Filter with >= start and < end_exclusive

post.summary: Holiday-aware job schedules: nth or last business day, weekly or cron with a holiday rule; next runs and run-today check

day.description: 1–31 (31 = month end in short months) or "last"

expression.description: Cron, 5 or 6 fields, max 96 runs a day

adjust.description: For weekend/holiday dates. modified_following: next, unless that is next month, then previous

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (default UTC)

week_start.description: First day of the week. monday = ISO weeks (labels like 2026-W46)
